title: Exact Dedekind numbers
exact_target: Count exactly the antichains in the subsets of an $n$-element set, or equivalently all monotone Boolean functions, for every $n\ge10$.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3200013 (AMR-031-0013). CC BY 4.0.
Patrick De Causmaecker and Lennart Van Hirtum, Solving systems of equations on antichains for the computation of the ninth Dedekind Number (2024), §§1,2.1–2.2, pp.1–5.
